messages.subject: Distance 7.0 object 'ddf.1' not found
parts:
Dear Google group, 

I'm running a DSM and using a detection function from the same version of Distance (7.0) and getting the "object 'ddf.1' not found" error. I have looked through the google group questions and the manual and tried turning off the check boxes under preferences>image properties>'remove new objects that are created with each run' and 'remove objects not associated with analysis in project after each run' however I am still getting the same error as before. I have rerun all analysis post unchecking these boxes and still the error appears. Finally, I downloaded the 6.2 version of distance, set the project up from scratch again and reran all the analysis from scratch and the error is still coming up. 

Any help would be greatly appreciated as unchecking the boxes is the only solution I can find for this one. 
Thanks in advance. 
Trisha

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Distance 7.0 object 'ddf.1' not found
parts:
Trisha

In Distance 7 the tab labels in the Preferences window have changed.  You should use "Preferences | R Options" to make sure the first two tick boxes are NOT checked, as you have already done.

My suspicion is that your trouble lies in the analysis engine you have used to fit your detection function.  You must use the MRDS analysis engine to fit your detection function, before moving on to the spatial modelling step in your analysis.  This is because it is the MRDS engine that creates objects of type "ddf" that Distance is not able to find (creating your error message).

Hope that is helpful.
